test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate homophones to fill in the blanks.

I ________ that he has been promoted to the post of _____ officer.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The homophone "**heard**" refers** to perceiving sound, which fits the context of the sentence.**
 
• The homophone "**sealing**" refers** to closing or securing something, which is appropriate for the context of the post of an officer.**
 
• Option 3 correctly uses **both homophones **to complete the sentence **meaningfully.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"I **heard** that he has been promoted to the post of **sealing **officer."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "heard; ceiling"** – While "heard" is correct, "ceiling" does not fit the context of the officer's post.
 
• **Option 2: "herd; sealing"** – "Herd" refers to a group of animals and is incorrect in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "herd; ceiling"** – Both words are incorrect in this context.
 
• **Option 5: – This option is invalid as it is incomplete or missing.**
